decisions.reason: The two-component injection unit sits in the firm's core plural-component line and got its own dedicated page, and it has had few years to recover its in-house engineering and manufacturing investment, so management would persist with it.

As a sibling injection unit with its own page, it carries the same visible commitment and sunk development cost as Product A, so dropping it would write off investment in a central direction of the firm.
Automatic airless guns are core to the firm's spray application business and complement its pumps, so the investment and public presentation favour keeping it.
A manual airless gun is a staple accessory that supports equipment and spare-parts sales, and it was presented prominently, so management would keep it.
A multi-model air-assisted airless line reflects the heaviest investment and the strongest visible commitment, which strongly favours persistence.

Its fall from a dedicated page to a mere mention in 2019 signals weaker commitment and makes it the most likely to be dropped, but it ties into the announced innovative application technology and weak results can still be put down to slow digital adoption, so it is kept for now.
